notes.title: “SWORDS OF GARGANTUA” SERVICE REOPENING
notes.notes:
After internal discussion and in response to our community’s opinions and multiple requests, we are happy to announce that the service of “SWORDS OF GARGANTUA”, which we previously announced would be terminated on September 30th 2022, will be resumed for Meta Quest and PCVR in early 2023. 

To prepare for the continuation of the online service, the service will be temporarily suspended on September 30, 2022 to allow time for online server relocation and additional technical modifications so that we can reopen service in early 2023. We are also planning support for an offline mode in the future. 

Future announcements will be shared through the official “SWORDS OF GARGANTUA” social media pages. We know dedicated fans have spent thousands of hours in SWORDS OF GARGANTUA, and so we will continue to make sincere efforts to ensure that players can continue enjoying VR content. 

We look forward to your continued patronage and support. Thank you.

September 30, 2022: Suspension of service
Early 2023: Service Reopening

Sincerely,
Producer Masaru Ohnogi

notes.title: New Mode Tesseract Abyss coming December 5th!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33507112/0bdadca29830fc668eca3bbcf72de33f224b7780.png[/img]

[b]Introducing Adventure Mode: Tesseract Abyss[/b]
Tesseract Abyss puts players into the deepest layers of the 4D space known as the “Tesseract”. By using weapons and coins earned by playing this mode, players (single or multiplayer) will be able to continue into the abyss, gradually becoming stronger through equipment and abilities.

[b]Level up your character![/b]
Player rank goes up as your performance does. As your rank increases so do abilities of your choosing.

[b]Become stronger through your abilities![/b]
You can use your earned coins to strengthen your abilities, such as overall HP or your strength.
Therefore, the more you play Tesseract Abyss the further you can progress!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33507112/0098eb307fe97acc1a584f58e6779975b0a90294.png[/img]

[b]Increase strength through weapon crafting[/b]
You can combine duplicate weapons to make stronger versions of themselves. Depending on your strategy, you can collect and strengthen a lot of weaker type weapons or earn more powerful weapons later on and speed up the process.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33507112/1ef937a3b2ac3a3442e235ea567eac7f7f11cd7a.png[/img]

[b]Give yourself a temporary boost through artifacts[/b]
Artifacts are consumable items that players can purchase for temporary buffs, such as strength or health boosts. They can be purchased with coins and then brought into battles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33507112/8e462dd37334318920abd84dba8be4bd3283cd32.png[/img]

[b]Carry items with you into the abyss[/b]
Bring your items and weapons into battle! Up to four weapons and/or artifacts can be brought into battle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33507112/bb30f0f2be7f403c8672e92de2fbaee0fa1e8cb0.png[/img]
